The lower side construction differs: Image #3 shows a horizontal teal rail across the entire side, while Image #2 and the base concept show a plain side panel extending to the bottom edge.

referenceSets.prompt: A simple stylized teal wooden toy cabinet: rectangular body, four short orange feet, two identical front doors with round orange handles, flat top and plain teal back. No writing, no extra accessories.
referenceSets.feedback: For EACH output render the requested tagged angle (front, side, back or three-quarter), not a different angle mentioned in feedback. Keep the exact base cabinet: teal wood, two identical front doors and orange knobs, four short orange legs. Front view must show both front doors and handles straight on. Left-side reference uses front/handles toward image RIGHT and rear toward image LEFT. Match the base side construction: plain tall side panel extends to the bottom edge; do not add a horizontal rail across the side. Back is plain teal. Preserve original proportions, top overhang, materials and lighting.
